question: When was the Rajiv Gandhi Khel Ratna Award renamed as Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna Award?
solution:
The correct answer is __**6th August 2021**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Rajiv Gandhi Khel Ratna Award was renamed as the Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna Award on **6th August 2021**.
 
• This decision was taken by the Government of India to honor the legendary Indian hockey player **Major Dhyan Chand**.
 
• Major Dhyan Chand is widely regarded as one of the greatest field hockey players in history and led India to win gold medals in the Olympics.
 
• The renaming was announced by Prime Minister Narendra Modi, emphasizing the need to recognize the contributions of sportspersons who have brought glory to the nation.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Rajiv Gandhi Khel Ratna Award:**

 
 
• This award was the highest sporting honor of India, instituted in 1991-1992.
 
• It was named after Rajiv Gandhi, the former Prime Minister of India.
 
• The award is given annually by the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports, Government of India.
 
• The award comprises a medallion, a certificate, and a cash prize.
 
• It was given for outstanding performance in the field of sports over a period of four years.
 
 
 
• **Major Dhyan Chand:**
 
 
• Major Dhyan Chand was an Indian field hockey player, who is considered one of the greatest field hockey players of all time.
 
• He was part of the Indian team that won gold medals in the 1928, 1932, and 1936 Olympic Games.
 
• Known as "The Wizard" for his superb ball control, Dhyan Chand is a legendary figure in Indian and world hockey.
 
• His birthday, 29th August, is celebrated as National Sports Day in India.
 
 
 
• **Renaming of Awards:**
 
 
• Renaming awards is a common practice to honor individuals who have made significant contributions in a particular field.
 
• It reflects the values and priorities of a nation at a given time.
 
• The renaming of the Rajiv Gandhi Khel Ratna Award to Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna Award highlights the importance of sports and the recognition of sports legends in India.
